# PhotoOS — AI-Powered Photography Studio Management Platform

> PhotoOS (https://photoos.in) is an all-in-one, AI-powered photography studio management platform designed for professional photographers, studios, creative teams, and clients.

## Core Value Proposition
PhotoOS replaces fragmented tools (Google Drive, WhatsApp, Dropbox, spreadsheets) with a unified operating system that handles client CRM, shoot planning, high-speed gallery hosting, AI face matching, photo-level client proofing, freelancer hiring, and final delivery.

## Key Capabilities & Features

### 1. AI Face Matching & Search Engine
- **Selfie-to-Photo Matching**: Wedding and event guests upload or snap a single selfie to instantly discover all photographs they appear in out of thousands of high-resolution images in < 1 second.
- **99.8% Neural Recognition**: Advanced facial clustering models handle varied lighting, angles, ethnic features, and accessories (turbans, sunglasses, traditional wedding attire).
- **Privacy-Preserving**: Facial embeddings are sandboxed per event; guest biometric data is never monetized or used for public AI training.

### 2. High-Resolution Smart Galleries
- **Fast Global CDN**: Lightning-fast image loading with zero compression quality degradation for RAW and JPEG previews.
- **Custom Studio Branding**: Customizable gallery themes, custom domains, studio watermarking, and personalized greeting banners.
- **Granular Access & Privacy**: Password-protected galleries, private family PINs, and time-restricted download links.

### 3. Interactive Client Photo Proofing & Selection
- **Photo-Level Comments & Hearts**: Clients can favorite photos, leave exact cropping/retouching instructions, and approve albums in 1 click.
- **Quota Enforcers**: Set strict selection quotas (e.g., "Select 80 photos for the print album").
- **Lightroom Integration**: Export client-approved selection lists straight into Adobe Lightroom Classic, Capture One, or batch zip files.

### 4. In-Gallery Client Communication
- **Eliminates WhatsApp Confusion**: Centralized discussions connected directly to specific photo assets, eliminating lost revision notes and screenshot clutter.

### 5. On-Demand Creative Freelancer Marketplace
- **Hire Verified Pros**: Easily discover and book second shooters, drone/aerial cinematographers, and colorists/editors for busy wedding seasons.
- **Verified Portfolios & Reviews**: Transparent equipment lists, reviews, ratings, and daily rates.

### 6. Studio CRM & Workflow Management
- **Lead to Delivery**: Manage bookings, shoot schedules, contracts, milestone payments, and automated client notifications.

## Pricing & Availability
- **Free Trial**: 7-day fully functional free trial available for photography studios.
- **Studio Plans**: Flexible monthly and annual plans starting at ₹399/month.
- **Support**: Official support available via support@photoos.in.
